festival.title: El Paso Parish Announced an October 3-4 Lebanese Festival
festival.body: Saint Sharbel Maronite Catholic Mission in El Paso announced a Lebanese Festival for October 3 and 4, 2026, with Lebanese food, live entertainment and dabke dancing. Those advertised dates have passed. This card preserves the original announcement, not a post-event report; attendance and the event outcome have not been verified.
festival.source: Parish announcement: Saint Sharbel Maronite Catholic Mission
anniversary.title: Emmitsburg Celebrates Nine Years of Saint Sharbel's Shrine
anniversary.body: The Family of Saint Sharbel USA reports that pilgrims gathered on September 26 at the National Shrine Grotto of Our Lady of Lourdes in Emmitsburg, Maryland, for the ninth anniversary of Saint Sharbel's shrine dedication. The celebration included Eucharistic Adoration, confessions and Mass celebrated by Father Theodore Trinko, IVE, at St. Mary's Glass Chapel. After Mass, pilgrims followed the saint's relic in procession to the shrine, where they received a blessing with Saint Sharbel's oil and venerated the relic. The organizer published its account on September 30.
anniversary.source: Family of Saint Sharbel USA: anniversary account (September 30, 2026)

consecration.title: Beirut Cathedral Consecrates an Altar to Blessed Patriarchs Douaihy and Hoayek
consecration.alt: Saint George Maronite Cathedral in downtown Beirut, with the Mohammad Al-Amin Mosque beside it
consecration.caption: Saint George Maronite Cathedral (left) and the Mohammad Al-Amin Mosque, downtown Beirut, 2009. Venue context, not the consecration Mass. Photo: Lebnen18, CC BY-SA 3.0; WebP conversion.
consecration.body: On Sunday, September 27, Maronite Patriarch Cardinal Bechara Boutros Al-Rahi presided over the consecration of an altar dedicated to Blessed Patriarchs Estephan Douaihy and Elias Hoayek at Saint George Maronite Cathedral in downtown Beirut, with the two patriarchs' relics placed within it. President Joseph Aoun attended, alongside religious and official figures and faithful from across Lebanon, especially Zgharta-Ehden, Douaihy's birthplace region. In his homily, Al-Rahi paired the two blesseds: Douaihy "preserved the church's memory and heritage amidst persecution," while Hoayek "carried the nation's cause amidst major transformations." Both remain Blessed, not canonized saints: Douaihy was beatified in 2024, Hoayek on July 25, 2026.

kfifan.title: Saint Charbel's Formation Monastery Receives Relics from Rome
kfifan.body: Kfifan's Monastery of Saints Cyprian and Justina received relics of its two patron saints from Rome, MTV Lebanon reported on October 2. Mass, a blessing and a procession marked their feast. Father Emile Akiki of the Lebanese Maronite Order led the Mass. Saint Charbel studied at Kfifan before his ordination, under Saint Nimatullah Al-Hardini. The report also recalls the monastery's connection with Blessed Estephan Nehme. These are relics of Cyprian and Justina, not Saint Charbel. The ceremony's exact calendar date is not specified.

galleryNews.title: From the Historic Photograph to a New Saint Charbel Art Series
galleryNews.intro: We have added an AI transformation series to our gallery, bringing the historic photograph of Saint Charbel into conversation with new devotional art. The original stays visible beside the renditions, so visitors can see the source and the artistic choices for themselves.
galleryNews.process: The collection shows the work as a series, from imagined portraits to close portraits and a comparison strip. The current first candidate has a dark beard with a grey center streak; the window portrait also has a dark beard. Other takes remain visible, so visitors can compare different artistic choices rather than seeing one image presented as a definitive likeness. The final and alternate renditions use the historic photograph as their reference; the early candidates are imagined portraits, not verified transformations of that source photograph.
galleryNews.honesty: We are proud to share the series, and we want its meaning to be clear. These are AI-assisted artistic renditions, not newly discovered photographs, a reconstruction of a documented scene or proof of an apparition. The gallery labels the new images as artistic renditions or "AI transformation, not a photograph." The historic photograph remains separately identified and credited. A personal-experience caption on the first candidate is presented as the website creator's own account, not independent verification.
galleryNews.invite: Explore the series in our gallery: open an image full-screen, compare the original and the renditions, and read the caption beside each piece.

tour.title: Lebanese and Jordanian Ministers Visit Saint Charbel's Pilgrimage Sites
tour.body: Lebanon's Tourism Minister Laura Al-Khazen Lahoud and Jordan's Tourism and Antiquities Minister Imad Hijazin visited Qozhaya monastery, Bqaa Kafra, Annaya and Saint Charbel's hermitage on Friday, according to the National News Agency's October 3 report. They met priests and monks and were briefed on Lebanon's religious trails, including the Lebanon Mountain Trail and the trail associated with Saint Charbel. The report describes a visit and briefing, not a new agreement or a trail opening.

opening.body: VOX Cinemas Lebanon lists Mar Charbel Movie as Now Showing, with a release date of October 21, 2026, a running time of 130 minutes, Arabic audio and English subtitles. On October 22 its City Centre Beirut page listed showtimes in both GOLD and Standard auditoriums. Cinemacity Beirut separately lists the film for October 22. These are cinema listings, not an attendance report or a seat guarantee; check your cinema's live film page for sessions. Lebanon24 reported on October 5 that the film would begin showing in Lebanese cinemas after an earlier postponement; its account of booking demand cites an unnamed source. The listings do not confirm an international rollout.

popeGemelli.title: Pope Leo shows steady improvement at Gemelli
popeGemelli.summary: Pope Leo XIV's doctors say October 16 blood tests and a chest X-ray confirmed steady improvement in his overall condition. Respiratory physiotherapy continues, and he can carry out normal daily activities independently. The Holy See Press Office says he celebrated Mass at noon for members of Gemelli's medical and nursing staff and the Vatican Gendarmerie, thanking those who care for the sick.
popeGemelli.aounParagraph: Aoun invoked Saint Charbel's intercession for Pope Leo XIV's recovery, conveying the Lebanese people's prayers in a message to the pontiff, LBC reported. He said the pope's visit to Lebanon remains firmly rooted in the hearts and the national and spiritual consciousness of the Lebanese, regardless of their religious affiliation.

popeRosary.title: Catholics Pray for Pope Leo at Gemelli
popeRosary.summary: An evening Rosary was held in Gemelli Hospital's chapel on October 13, presided over by Cardinal Baldassarre Reina, according to Catholic News Service reporting published by the USCCB. Churches and religious communities in Rome were also invited to join in prayer. The Holy See later reported that the Pope's operation was completed successfully.

popeGemelli.homeTitle: Pope Leo XIV cancels Assisi peace-meeting visit on doctors' advice
popeGemelli.homeCredit: Pope Leo XIV will not take part in the "Unarmed and Disarming Peace" meeting in Assisi on October 27, the Holy See Press Office announced on Friday. His doctors, Dr Luigi Carbone and Professor Stefano Margaritora, advised against the planned helicopter journey so soon after his October 13 thoracic surgery, and a scheduled follow-up chest X-ray confirmed that his postoperative recovery is progressing very well. The Pope will send a message expressing his closeness to the organizers, religious leaders and guests taking part. The St. Egidio Community meeting (October 25-27) marks the 40th anniversary of the World Day of Prayer for Peace convened by Saint John Paul II in Assisi in 1986. Context photo: Gemelli Hospital, Rome. Photo: Blackcat, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 IT; resized to WebP.

popeGemelliDischarge.title: Pope Leo discharged from Gemelli, back at the Vatican
popeGemelliDischarge.summary: Pope Leo XIV was discharged from Gemelli Hospital on Saturday afternoon following lung surgery on Tuesday and returned to the papal apartments in Vatican City. Before leaving, he celebrated Mass in the room set aside for that purpose on the 10th floor. On Sunday he prayed the midday Angelus with thousands of faithful gathered in St Peter's Square - his first scheduled public event since being discharged - thanking the doctors, nurses and staff of Gemelli and all who prayed for him: 'I have truly felt your support.' On Wednesday, October 21, he held his first weekly General Audience since the surgery in St Peter's Square, Vatican News reported; he thanked people for their prayers and spoke on marriage and the family in his catechesis on Gaudium et Spes. RTE and ANSA also reported on the audience. Vatican News also reported that, on the evening of October 21, his doctors, Dr Luigi Carbone and Professor Stefano Margaritora, issued a statement released by the Holy See Press Office: "The final histopathology and molecular testing reports on the tissue removed during the Holy Father's surgery were issued today. The results confirmed that the tumor was a lung adenocarcinoma and that the disease was localized. A subsequent oncological assessment has confirmed that no further treatment is necessary."

ddfVenite.title: Vatican Doctrinal Dicastery Publishes 'Venite ad Me' on Handing On the Faith
ddfVenite.summary: The Dicastery for the Doctrine of the Faith published 'Venite ad Me: Considerations on the Transmission of the Faith in an Epochal Change' on October 22. The Dicastery presents it as a set of Considerations, not a doctrinal note, calling for a renewed proclamation of the Gospel and new paths for evangelizing adults as well as catechizing children. Vatican News reports Pope Leo XIV approved the document on August 21, 2026.

popeAssisi.title: Pope Leo XIV cancels Assisi peace-meeting visit on doctors' advice
popeAssisi.summary: The Holy See Press Office announced on Friday that Pope Leo XIV will not take part in the "Unarmed and Disarming Peace" meeting in Assisi on October 27. His doctors, Dr Luigi Carbone and Professor Stefano Margaritora, advised against the planned helicopter journey so soon after his October 13 thoracic surgery, and a scheduled follow-up chest X-ray confirmed that his postoperative recovery is progressing very well. The Pope will send a message expressing his closeness to the organizers, religious leaders and guests taking part. The St. Egidio Community meeting (October 25-27) marks the 40th anniversary of the World Day of Prayer for Peace convened by Saint John Paul II in Assisi in 1986, bringing together 384 representatives from 53 countries. Reuters reports the Vatican has not said whether the Pope's scheduled November 6-17 trip to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru will go ahead.

massabkiCentenary.title: Al-Rahi celebrates Mass in Al-Aqoura for first centenary of Massabki brothers' beatification
massabkiCentenary.summary: Maronite Patriarch Bechara al-Rahi celebrated the Divine Liturgy in Al-Aqoura on Sunday for the first centenary of the beatification of the Massabki brothers. "The Massabki gave their lives for Christ, and their family traces its roots to the town of Al-Aqoura, and this town today takes them back and takes back their memory," he said, adding that "their holiness did not begin at the hour of martyrdom but appeared in their faith, their prayer and their love of doing good." Beatified by Pope Pius XI on October 10, 1926, the brothers Francis, Abdel Moati and Raphael were canonized by Pope Francis on October 20, 2024, the first Maronite laymen to be canonized; they were martyred in Damascus on the night of July 9-10, 1860, and belonged to the Maronite Eparchy of Damascus. Al-Aqoura mayor Boutros Mehanna had announced that the Patriarch would preside at Mar Girgis Cathedral, describing it as a religious and national celebration affirming the holiness of the town, region and Lebanon.
